title: kcapi provider: HKDF via kernel crypto shash
description: Implement the KDF provider callback for HKDF in the kcapi provider. The kernel crypto API exposes HKDF via the shash interface on kernels >= 5.15. Check for CONFIG_CRYPTO_HKDF availability. If available, use crypto_shash to drive HKDF with HMAC-SHA256 / HMAC-SHA384 / HMAC-SHA512. If not available, fall back to -ENOTSUP (wolfssl provider handles it). Provider must: (1) read IKM from inbuf or ikm_fd reference, (2) extract+expand with salt and info from crypto2dev_kdf_op, (3) write OKM directly to key_ctx, (4) zeroize transient buffers. Depends on WOLFKM-ely (UAPI struct) and WOLFKM-nid (design/callback contract).
